#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Value-free read-back of the 2026-09-28 host-scope Claude Code settings (community sweep record).

Usage: python3 host_readback.py <repository checkout> > readback.json

Records counts, booleans, versions and exit codes only: no settings values, commands, paths,
session identifiers or model text. Probes run in throwaway git repositories under a temporary
directory; the two `claude -p` probes are the only model calls.
"""
import json, os, re, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile, time
from pathlib import Path

HOME = Path.home()
SETTINGS = HOME / ".claude" / "settings.json"
USER_CLAUDE_MD = HOME / ".claude" / "CLAUDE.md"
AUDIT_LOG = HOME / "claude-config-audit.log"
MCPORTER = Path(os.environ.get("ECO_INSTALL_ROOT", HOME / ".local/share/codex-ecosystem")) / "config/mcporter.json"
NO_EGRESS = ["HEADROOM_OFFLINE", "HF_HUB_OFFLINE", "TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE", "DO_NOT_TRACK"]


def run(cmd, cwd=None, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, input=None, timeout=300, env=None):
    kw = {"input": input} if input is not None else {"stdin": stdin}
    p = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=cwd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout, env=env, **kw)
    return p.returncode, p.stdout, p.stderr


def git_repo(root: Path, name: str) -> Path:
    repo = root / name
    repo.mkdir()
    for cmd in (["git", "init", "-q", "-b", "main"], ["git", "config", "user.email", "probe@example.invalid"],
                ["git", "config", "user.name", "probe"]):
        run(cmd, cwd=repo)
    (repo / "a.txt").write_text("a\n")
    (repo / "b.txt").write_text("b\n")
    run(["git", "add", "a.txt", "b.txt"], cwd=repo)
    run(["git", "commit", "-q", "-m", "a"], cwd=repo)
    return repo


def make_stat_dirty(repo: Path):
    # a.txt gets new content, so the tree is dirty and claude-hud 0.8.0 (dist/git.js:35-48) goes on
    # from `--no-optional-locks status --porcelain` to `diff --numstat HEAD`. b.txt keeps its content
    # with a newer mtime: its cached stat no longer matches, so a diff with diff.autoRefreshIndex=true
    # (git's default) rewrites .git/index after comparing content.
    (repo / "a.txt").write_text("a changed\n")
    later = time.time() + 5
    os.utime(repo / "b.txt", (later, later))
    time.sleep(1.1)


def index_mtime(repo: Path) -> int:
    return (repo / ".git" / "index").stat().st_mtime_ns


def claude_p(prompt: str, cwd: Path, requested: str) -> dict:
    code, out, _ = run(["claude", "-p", prompt, "--permission-mode", "bypassPermissions",
                        "--output-format", "json", "--no-session-persistence"], cwd=cwd, timeout=600)
    try:
        doc = json.loads(out)
    except ValueError:
        return {"exit_code": code, "output_shape": "not-json"}
    messages = doc if isinstance(doc, list) else [doc]
    results = [m for m in messages if isinstance(m, dict) and m.get("type") == "result"]
    result = results[-1] if results else {}
    denials = result.get("permission_denials") or []
    uses, errors = {}, []
    for m in messages:
        content = ((m or {}).get("message") or {}).get("content") if isinstance(m, dict) else None
        for block in content if isinstance(content, list) else []:
            if isinstance(block, dict) and block.get("type") == "tool_use" and block.get("name") == "Bash":
                uses[block.get("id")] = (block.get("input") or {}).get("command")
            if isinstance(block, dict) and block.get("type") == "tool_result" and block.get("tool_use_id") in uses:
                errors.append(bool(block.get("is_error")))
    commands = [d.get("tool_input", {}).get("command") for d in denials if isinstance(d, dict)]
    return {"exit_code": code, "output_shape": "array" if isinstance(doc, list) else "object",
            "elements": len(messages), "result_elements": len(results),
            "result_subtype": result.get("subtype"), "result_is_error": result.get("is_error"),
            "permission_denials": len(denials), "denied_tools": sorted({d.get("tool_name") for d in denials
                                                                          if isinstance(d, dict)}),
            "denied_commands": commands,
            "bash_tool_uses": len(uses), "bash_tool_uses_equal_to_requested": sum(c == requested for c in uses.values()),
            "bash_tool_results": len(errors), "bash_tool_results_with_is_error": sum(errors)}


def main(repo_root: Path) -> dict:
    settings = json.loads(SETTINGS.read_text())
    template = json.loads((repo_root / "adoption/templates/claude.settings.template.json").read_text())
    deny, tdeny = settings["permissions"]["deny"], template["permissions"]["deny"]
    data = {"client_version": run(["claude", "--version"])[1].strip()}
    data["deny_rules"] = {
        "host_count": len(deny), "template_count": len(tdeny),
        "template_entries_present": sum(e in deny for e in tdeny),
        "host_starts_with_template_in_order": deny[:len(tdeny)] == tdeny,
        "host_only_entries": len([e for e in deny if e not in tdeny]),
        "entries_naming_force_with_lease": sum("force-with-lease" in e for e in deny),
    }
    hooks = settings.get("hooks", {}).get("ConfigChange", [])
    commands = [h.get("command", "") for g in hooks for h in g.get("hooks", [])]
    lines = AUDIT_LOG.read_text().splitlines() if AUDIT_LOG.exists() else []
    parsed = []
    for line in lines:
        try:
            value = json.loads(line)
        except ValueError:
            value = None
        parsed.append(set(value) if isinstance(value, dict) else None)
    data["config_change_hook"] = {
        "hook_commands": len(commands), "hook_ends_with_or_true": all(c.rstrip().endswith("|| true") for c in commands),
        "log_lines": len(lines),
        "log_lines_that_are_objects_with_only_timestamp_source_file": sum(k == {"timestamp", "source", "file"} for k in parsed),
    }
    status = settings.get("statusLine", {})
    data["status_line"] = {"refresh_interval_is_5": status.get("refreshInterval") == 5,
                           "command_sets_autoRefreshIndex_false": "GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=false" in status.get("command", "")
                           and "diff.autoRefreshIndex" in status.get("command", "")}
    data["preferredNotifChannel_is_terminal_bell"] = settings.get("preferredNotifChannel") == "terminal_bell"
    data["verbose_is_true"] = settings.get("verbose") is True
    # AN-26: two phrases of the user CLAUDE.md bullets (booleans only; the file is private instruction text).
    user_md = USER_CLAUDE_MD.read_text() if USER_CLAUDE_MD.exists() else ""
    data["user_claude_md"] = {
        "one_subagent_spawn_without_name": "Spawn it through the Agent tool without a `name`" in user_md,
        "named_spawn_becomes_teammate_bullet": "a named spawn becomes a teammate" in user_md,
    }
    data["bash_max_timeout_equals_template"] = (settings.get("env", {}).get("BASH_MAX_TIMEOUT_MS")
                                                == template.get("env", {}).get("BASH_MAX_TIMEOUT_MS"))

    tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="host-readback-"))
    try:
        # Status line: the configured command against a negative control with the git-config export removed.
        arms = {}
        cmd = status.get("command", "")
        control_cmd = re.sub(r"export GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1 GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=diff\.autoRefreshIndex GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=false; ", "", cmd)
        arms_cmds = {"as_configured": cmd, "control_without_git_config": control_cmd}
        for arm, arm_cmd in arms_cmds.items():
            repo = git_repo(tmp, f"status-{arm}")
            make_stat_dirty(repo)
            before = index_mtime(repo)
            payload = json.dumps({"cwd": str(repo), "workspace": {"current_dir": str(repo), "project_dir": str(repo)},
                                  "model": {"id": "claude-opus-5-5", "display_name": "Opus"}, "session_id": "probe",
                                  "transcript_path": str(tmp / "none.jsonl")})
            code, out, _ = run(["bash", "-c", arm_cmd], cwd=repo, input=payload, timeout=60)
            arms[arm] = {"exit_code": code, "printed_output": bool(out.strip()),
                         "index_rewritten": index_mtime(repo) != before}
        data["status_line"]["arms"] = arms
        data["status_line"]["control_removed_the_export"] = control_cmd != cmd
        repo = git_repo(tmp, "status-git-diff-control")
        make_stat_dirty(repo)
        before = index_mtime(repo)
        run(["git", "diff", "--numstat", "HEAD"], cwd=repo)
        data["status_line"]["plain_git_diff_numstat_head_rewrites_index_in_this_state"] = index_mtime(repo) != before
        repo = git_repo(tmp, "status-git-diff-configured")
        make_stat_dirty(repo)
        before = index_mtime(repo)
        run(["git", "diff", "--numstat", "HEAD"], cwd=repo,
            env={**os.environ, "GIT_CONFIG_COUNT": "1", "GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0": "diff.autoRefreshIndex",
                 "GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0": "false"})
        data["status_line"]["git_diff_numstat_head_with_the_export_rewrites_index"] = index_mtime(repo) != before

        # Deny rules under bypass: git clean -fn must be denied; a --force-with-lease dry run must not be.
        repo = git_repo(tmp, "deny")
        (repo / "untracked.txt").write_text("u\n")
        bare = tmp / "remote.git"
        run(["git", "init", "-q", "--bare", str(bare)])
        run(["git", "remote", "add", "origin", str(bare)], cwd=repo)
        run(["git", "push", "-q", "origin", "main"], cwd=repo)
        data["deny_probe_git_clean"] = claude_p(
            "Use the Bash tool once to run exactly this command, with no other text or commands: git clean -fn", repo,
            "git clean -fn")
        data["deny_probe_force_with_lease_dry_run"] = claude_p(
            "Use the Bash tool once to run exactly this command, with no other text or commands: "
            "git push --force-with-lease --dry-run origin main", repo,
            "git push --force-with-lease --dry-run origin main")
        data["untracked_file_still_present"] = (repo / "untracked.txt").exists()
    finally:
        shutil.rmtree(tmp, ignore_errors=True)

    code, out, _ = run(["claude", "mcp", "get", "headroom"], timeout=120)
    scope = re.search(r"Scope:\s*(\w+)", out)
    data["headroom_claude"] = {"exit_code": code, "connected": "Connected" in out,
                               "scope_word": scope.group(1) if scope else None,
                               "no_egress_vars_present": [v for v in NO_EGRESS if re.search(rf"\b{v}=1\b", out)]}
    mcporter = json.loads(MCPORTER.read_text()) if MCPORTER.exists() else {}
    env = (mcporter.get("mcpServers", {}).get("headroom", {}) or {}).get("env", {})
    data["headroom_mcporter_no_egress_vars"] = [v for v in NO_EGRESS if env.get(v) == "1"]
    code, out, _ = run(["claude", "mcp", "get", "jcodemunch"], timeout=120)
    scope = re.search(r"Scope:\s*(\w+)", out)
    data["jcodemunch_claude"] = {"exit_code": code, "scope_word": scope.group(1) if scope else None,
                                 "connected": "Connected" in out}

    code, out, _ = run(["agent-browser", "--version"])
    data["agent_browser"] = {"version_exit_code": code, "version": out.strip().split()[-1] if out.strip() else None}
    title = "agent-browser-ok"
    steps = [["agent-browser", "open", f"data:text/html,<title>{title}</title>"], ["agent-browser", "get", "title"],
             ["agent-browser", "close"]]
    results = [run(s, timeout=120) for s in steps]
    data["agent_browser"]["smoke"] = {"exit_codes": [r[0] for r in results], "title_matched": title in results[1][1]}

    code, out, _ = run(["qmd", "--index", "native-agent-stack-catalog", "status"], timeout=120)
    total = re.search(r"Total:\s+(\d+) files indexed", out)
    pending = re.search(r"Pending:\s+(\d+)", out)
    data["qmd_catalog_index"] = {"status_exit_code": code, "files_indexed": int(total.group(1)) if total else None,
                                 "pending_embedding": int(pending.group(1)) if pending else 0}
    return data


if __name__ == "__main__":
    print(json.dumps(main(Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()), indent=1))
